_comment: A creature is a FILE. Everything the waves need to field one lives here -- adding a species to the bestiary is writing one of these plus a drawing, never touching code. sheet is the species' three stats; hp/contact/speed/xp derive from them through swarm.json's bestiary block, scaled off base. growth is which stats gain points per level of depth -- each species deepens along its own character. movement declares the species' gait; a file that omits the block walks plainly. guide is the species' printed field-guide page, the trade's six sections; a file without the block is a species the book does not know, and an empty string is a section not yet written.
